newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close up, seen heading higher.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close up, seen heading higher.

text.p: Austrian shares closed marginally firmer on Wednesday after a lacklustre session and traders said the ATX, moving in a narrow range, was likely to continue its upward trend in the short term.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips was well supported at 1,100 points, with near targets between 1,120 and 1,130 points, traders said.
"The 1,100 level is now confirmed," said one.
Dealers said there was heavy selective buying in oil and chemicals group OMV towards the end of the session.
"Money is still coming in there. OMV has further to go," said one.
The ATX index climbed 3.26 points or 0.30 percent to 1,105.65. Ten shares rose, nine fell and two remained unchanged.

Austria Mikro Systeme, or AMS, was the top gainer, up 3.25 percent to 829 schillings, building on recent gains amid optimism over the company's profit outlook and a global revival in semiconductor stocks.
The leading decliner of the session was Vienna airport group Flughafen, dropping 2.26 percent to 475 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index added 0.91 points or 0.22 percent to end at 420.28.
The December ATX future gained 2.7 points to 1,109.2.
